purpose: Select what belongs in the human environmental-management review without preselecting favorite pollutants or forcing every available number into the brief.

selection_gates.rule: Inventory all available source-native metrics/items first. A metric is never selected merely because it is familiar or easy to plot.
Long-term trend interpretation requires at least 4 observations under the same source-native definition. Two or three observations are context only. Definition changes remain separate.

Detect mathematical candidates such as directional movement, level-shift candidates, persistence, composition change and daily variability. A signal is a reason to inspect, not a performance or risk conclusion.
Check whether the metric/topic is connected to a site management facility, multi-year action/investment, company management statement, regulation/hazard reference, process context or BAT reference.

Do not call a value high/low, improved/worsened, compliant/non-compliant or efficient/inefficient when required denominators, site-specific limits, inlet load, production scale or operating conditions are missing.

signal_rules.directional: With 4+ comparable observations, at least 75% of non-zero adjacent changes have the same sign.
signal_rules.level_shift_candidate: With 4+ comparable observations, the largest absolute adjacent change is at least twice the median non-zero absolute adjacent change. This is only a mathematical review candidate.
signal_rules.persistent_chemical: The same PRTR chemical appears in at least 3 source-native reporting years.
signal_rules.definition_change: A source changes the reported metric/definition and the old/new series must not be stitched into one trend.
signal_rules.daily_variability: For available daily TMS rows, retain N, mean, median, P95, maximum and coefficient of variation as descriptive statistics only.

display_levels.EVIDENCE: Preserve in evidence outputs; not necessarily shown in the main brief.
display_levels.OVERVIEW: Show to explain what the site/media manages or what data exists; no dedicated trend chart required.
display_levels.MAIN: Show in the main review when comparable data plus a review signal or management relevance changes what the user should inspect next.
display_levels.DEEP_DIVE_CANDIDATE: Eligible for deeper review only when at least two independent evidence dimensions overlap. Human adoption is still required.

AIR.inventory: All source-native air metrics from CleanSYS and ENV-INFO.
AIR.main_rule: Do not repeat every pollutant for every site. Promote only comparable metrics with a signal and/or same-site air-management action.

WATER.inventory: All available pH, organic-load, solids, nutrient, flow and discharge-load fields from SOOSIRO and ENV-INFO.
WATER.main_rule: No preselected representative such as T-N. Select after inventory/comparability. Treat COD->TOC as a definition/measurement transition rather than a single continuous trend.

CHEMICALS.inventory: All PRTR release/transfer chemicals and chemical-statistics substances/products.
CHEMICALS.main_rule: Release quantity alone is not priority. Combine persistence, release/transfer path, regulatory/hazard flags, process/BAT relevance and company action where available.

WASTE.inventory: Total and available waste categories, recycling, treatment/action evidence.
WASTE.main_rule: Prefer changes in waste composition, treatment/recycling route or material company action over repeating total generation alone.

GHG_ENERGY.inventory: Site GHG/energy and company-level gas/target/action evidence without forcing incompatible scope definitions together.
GHG_ENERGY.main_rule: Absolute site emissions may provide scale/context but cannot rank environmental performance without production/product-mix denominators.

WATER_RESOURCES.inventory: Water use, reuse and reuse/conservation actions.
WATER_RESOURCES.main_rule: Keep resource-use interpretation separate from effluent-quality interpretation.

management_action.window: Use every available year in ENV-INFO, not only the latest year.
management_action.cross_source_link_rule: Time/topic/site overlap may create an AI_REVIEW candidate, never an automatic causal claim.

hard_boundaries: Never select a metric merely because it was selected in a previous company.
Never interpret a short series as a long-term trend.
Never stitch changed measurement definitions into one trend without an explicit bridge.
Never equate PRTR quantity with hazard or risk.
Never infer treatment efficiency from effluent values without inlet/load information.
Never infer legal compliance without the applicable site/facility-specific requirement.
Never state that an investment caused a measured change solely from temporal overlap.
